claim: In Q1 2024, Apple's revenue came in at $77.1 billion or more.
summary: Without tool evidence, based only on internal knowledge to cutoff 2026-01-04, Apple's reported revenue for both interpretations of Q1 2024 exceeds the $77.1B threshold: fiscal Q1 2024 (Dec 2023 quarter) ~$119.58B and calendar Q1 2024 (fiscal Q2 2024) ~$90.75B. No evidence_ids available due to no-tool constraint.

sub_claims.text: Apple's revenue in Q1 2024 was greater than or equal to $77.1 billion
sub_claims.stated_text: In Q1 2024, Apple's revenue came in at $77.1 billion or more.
sub_claims.note: No tool evidence available; verdict based only on model knowledge. Both fiscal Q1 2024 (~119.58B) and calendar Q1 2024 (~90.75B) exceed 77.1B, so 'or more' condition is met.
